name: Kami-sama
source:
After repeated failure to bring together the lovers who come to pray at her shrine, this poor goddess' charms have gained a reputation as "charms of misfortune". When she notices that Ichitaro and Yachiyo only need one final push to get together, she focuses all her efforts on strengthening their bond...

[From [url=http://frontwing.jp/product/loca-love/en/index.html#chara]English official website[/url]]
